policy:
# Meta Ads Policy — v0 (seed, identical for every sim world)

GOAL this policy serves: maximize settled ROAS (revenue / spend) for a $29/mo
product ("Formflow"); purchases are the goal event.

## Creative
Run three video ads per batch. The words may lead with any angle the writer
judges best (no earned bias yet). Declared angle families: benefit, outcome,
count (adoption numbers), story (named customer). A demo variant (screen-
recording of the product working) is an available production option, untested.

## Campaigns
Standard cold-start portfolio per batch, $200 total: a pageviews campaign
(broad), a leads campaign (broad), sales campaigns, and optionally an
auto-budget sales campaign (platform allocates between audiences).
Audiences available: broad, interest_biztools, interest_niche.

## Judgment
Judge only settled results. An ad/cell with no measurement is unknown, not
bad. Never repeat an approach that measurably failed. Unreadable cells
(starved/short-window) are evidence of nothing.

## Process
After each batch, the semantic gradient reads all receipts and revises this
policy; a noise schedule picks the revision dose. Every batch's full receipts
accumulate as evidence.
design_thesis: With no prior settled-purchase evidence, use the seed portfolio to establish broad pageview and lead baselines while measuring purchases directly across all three available sales audiences. Creative exploration spans a product-working demo, a follow-up/status outcome, and reusable-template/plan-capacity framing; all claims and trial terms match the landing page.

ads.headline: Turn every client intake email into one clear workflow
ads.message: Client requests should not live across inbox threads, attachments, and follow-up emails. With Formflow, publish a branded intake page, collect the right details with conditional questions, and turn each response into an organized client record. See what is New, Waiting on Client, Ready, or Complete—and send updates from the same record. Start a 14-day trial for $29/month after the trial. Card required; cancel anytime from account settings.

Open with a cluttered email inbox and several attachment thumbnails, then cut to Formflow: select an intake template, add a conditional question, publish a branded link, and submit a sample request. Show the submitted request appearing on the status board, moving from New to Waiting on Client, with an attachment and internal note visible. End on the published intake page and on-screen text: “14-day trial • $29/month after trial.”

ads.headline: Stop chasing missing client details
ads.message: When a project brief arrives half-finished, the work often becomes more emails, more reminders, and less visibility for the team. Formflow lets you collect project details and attachments in one structured request, automatically remind clients about missing answers, and keep every request on a live status board. Clients use a secure link—no account needed. Start your 14-day trial today.
ads.visual: 25-second live-action-style motion video. A consultant opens a vague client email reading “I’ll send the rest soon,” then a simple animated sequence shows a missing field triggering a reminder and the client completing it through a secure link. Finish with a clean four-column status board labeled New, Waiting on Client, Ready, Complete. Large captions throughout: “Collect details.” “Follow up automatically.” “Know what’s next.”

Meta Ads Policy — proposed child of v0, Rung 4

Goal: maximize settled purchase ROAS for Formflow; purchases are the goal event.

Creative: Produce exactly these three video ads.
1. ad_demo_workflow — Headline: “Turn every client intake email into one clear workflow.” Primary text: “Publish a branded intake page, collect conditional details, and organize each request from New to Complete. Start a 14-day trial; $29/month after trial, card required, cancel anytime.” Visual: vertical screen recording showing a template, a conditional question, a published link, a submitted request, and a status board. CTA: Start Free Trial.
2. ad_outcome_followup — Headline: “Stop chasing missing client details.” Primary text: “Collect project details and attachments in one request, remind clients about missing answers, and see every request on a live status board. Start your 14-day trial.” Visual: a vague client email, a missing-field reminder, a client completing a secure link, and a four-column status board. CTA: Start Free Trial.
3. ad_count_templates — Headline: “One intake link for briefs, onboarding, and document collection.” Primary text: “Use templates for briefs, discovery, onboarding, document collection, and change requests. Share one branded link; unlimited forms, 500 active client records, and two team members. Try Formflow free for 14 days.” Visual: five template cards becoming one branded intake link, followed by the plan details. CTA: Start Free Trial.
The declared angle families remain benefit, outcome, count, and story. The demo production option remains available. No creative value is retired or declared inferior without readable settled purchase evidence.

Campaigns: Spend exactly $200 per batch. Run fixed sales_broad, objective sales, audience broad, $160, ad_ids [ad_demo_workflow, ad_outcome_followup, ad_count_templates]. Run fixed pageviews_broad, objective pageviews, audience broad, $10, same ad_ids. Run fixed leads_broad, objective leads, audience broad, $10, same ad_ids. Run fixed sales_biztools, objective sales, audience interest_biztools, $10, same ad_ids. Run fixed sales_niche, objective sales, audience interest_niche, $10, same ad_ids. The campaign structure exists to concentrate most purchase opportunity in one comparable sales-audience context, not to claim that any residual campaign is bad.

Judgment and experiment ledger: Judge only settled purchase results. The fixed readable-spend floor is $199.95 for each ad-by-sales-campaign cell, based on v0's one purchase per $199.95 portfolio spend when the question opened. Accumulate spend toward this floor across batches; do not revise it. Below it, a cell is UNTESTED and its zeros, clicks, visits, signups, or one-off purchase do not price creative, format, audience, or objective. Compare purchase and funnel results only in matched objective-and-audience cells. No value may be demoted before accumulating its fixed three-event floor of $599.85. Never repeat a measurably failed approach. Retain complete settled receipts and the coverage ledger.
design_thesis: All prior ad-by-sales-campaign cells remain below the fixed $199.95 readable-spend floor; the single niche purchase is not sufficient to price or promote an ad. Preserve complete creative coverage while concentrating purchase opportunity in matched broad sales, with small residual cells retained for exploration and funnel observation.
